item.title: Tesla Will Stop Making the Cybertruck in 2027, Musk Says
item.description: The CEO said on X that the Texas factory space will go to the two-seat Cybercab robotaxi, according to TechCrunch.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Reportedly in Talks to Buy AI-Agent Security Startup Clutch for $500 Million
item.description: The Information first reported the cash-plus-milestones deal, which TechCrunch says would value the three-year-old company at about 50 times annual recurring revenue.

item.title: OpenAI's Brockman Says Company Could Be Ready to Go Public in 2027
item.description: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal conference, the president said enterprise revenue doubled in the third quarter and that early 2026 was "pretty rough" for that business.

item.title: Qualcomm Handset Revenue Falls 26% in Fiscal Q4 as Automotive Sales Hit a Record
item.description: Total revenue slipped 8% to $10.3 billion; the company guided to $10.4 billion to $11.2 billion for the next quarter.

item.title: Snap Posts Q3 Net Income of $56 Million on 14% Revenue Growth, Will Switch to MAU Metric
item.description: Revenue reached $1.72 billion and adjusted EBITDA more than doubled, while North America daily users fell 6%.

item.title: Apple Reportedly Cuts Daily AI Spending Caps for Engineering Teams
item.description: Bloomberg reported the limit fell from $300 to $200 a day in October, with further cuts planned and a cap as low as $25 under consideration elsewhere in the company.

item.title: AMD Q3 Revenue Rises 45% to $13.4 Billion as Data Center Sales Nearly Double
item.description: The chipmaker guides to about $17 billion for the fourth quarter, while gaming revenue fell 40%.

item.title: Google to Turn Off Search for Student Accounts at K-12 Schools That Ban AI, Report Says
item.description: From early 2027, Google's AI products will be off by default for K-12 student accounts until administrators enable them.

item.title: Oracle Launches $20 Billion Stock and Bond Sales to Fund AI Buildout, Shares Fall Nearly 9%
item.description: The company is reportedly selling $10 billion of new shares and $10 billion of notes, the split it outlined at its October 28 investor day.

item.title: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in All-Stock Deal Valued at $115 Billion Including Debt
item.description: TechCrunch reports the optical networking deal exchanges 4.5 Marvell shares for each Lumentum share and is not expected to close until the first half of 2028.

item.title: Germany's Cyber Agency Says Lawmakers Received Apple Spyware Warnings
item.description: The BSI told recipients to assume their iPhones may be compromised; Apple said the latest threat notifications went to users in 99 countries.

item.title: Apple Inventory Jumps 154% as CEO Ternus Calls Memory Pricing "Unprecedented"
item.description: The company guided to a 45% to 46% gross margin for the December quarter, down from 47.9%, and did not rule out future device price increases.

item.title: Anthropic's Amended IPO Filing Says It "May Imminently Meet" Its Threshold for AI-Accelerated Progress
item.description: The S-1/A, reported by TechCrunch, links AI-driven model development to safety risk and says no current model has been designated as crossing the line.

item.title: Public Exploit Released for Android "SMS of Death" Flaw That Crashes Unpatched Phones
item.description: CVE-2026-58882 was fixed for Android 14 through 17 in October, but Android 12 and 13 devices remain exposed to a text message that can crash the phone process.

item.title: Northflank Breach Leads to Abuse of Customers' AI API Keys, Wiz Reports Wave of Incidents
item.description: The cloud platform told users to assume environment variables were decrypted; Wiz counts at least nine October incidents at AI developer platforms.

item.title: Trojanized Claude Code Extension on Cursor's Marketplace Tried to Plant SSH Backdoors
item.description: A malicious build posing as Anthropic's extension was live for about 11 hours on October 29; researchers say the backdoor largely failed to open remote access.

item.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic Agree to Honor a Shared robots.txt Opt-Out for AI Training
item.description: Websites will be able to refuse AI training across four major companies with a single entry, though only Anthropic has begun supporting it.

item.title: Binance Says Compromised Engineer Laptop Led to Roughly $6.3 Billion Crypto Theft; Analysts Blame North Korea
item.description: TRM Labs and Elliptic attribute the record heist to the TraderTraitor group, while Binance says about $3 billion has been frozen.

item.title: OpenAI Reportedly Cuts Funding Round Target to About $20 Billion as AI Stocks Slide
item.description: The Financial Times says the target fell from $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation; the Wall Street Journal reports roughly $11 billion in commitments so far.

item.title: Chainalysis Discloses Breach Involving AI-Driven Attack; Says It Is Unrelated to Binance Theft
item.description: The blockchain analytics firm says customer names, emails, user IDs and role labels were exposed, but it found no sign of credentials or investigation data being accessed.

item.title: Amazon Q3: AWS Sales Grow 39%, Fastest in Nearly Five Years, as 2026 Capex Heads to $220 Billion
item.description: Net sales rose 12% to $201.9 billion and operating margin hit a record 13.9%, while trailing free cash flow turned negative on AI spending.

item.title: Intel Q3 Revenue Rises 21% to $16.5 Billion as Data Center Sales Jump 78%
item.description: The chipmaker says its priority is unlocking more Xeon supply, while its CFO expects the PC slowdown to last through the first half of 2027.

item.title: Amazon's Jassy Says Outside Shopping Agents Are 'Not Great' a Month After Blocking Meta's Muse
item.description: On the Q3 earnings call, the CEO said few customers buy through third-party AI agents and touted Amazon's own Alexa for shopping.

item.title: Google Rolls Out Chrome Autofill That Uses Gemini to Pull Order and Flight Details From Gmail
item.description: The "enhanced autofill" feature is available in the US for Gemini in Chrome users who have Personal Intelligence turned on.

item.title: Alphabet Q3 Revenue Rises 25% to $127.6 Billion as Google Cloud Sales Jump 103%
item.description: Cloud operating income tripled to $11.1 billion, while Search growth slowed to 12% and free cash flow turned negative.

item.title: Microsoft Discloses Azure Revenue in Dollars for First Time: $33.2 Billion, Up 48%
item.description: Fiscal first-quarter revenue rose 19% to $92.3 billion, and the company guided to even faster Azure growth next quarter.

item.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, a Cybersecurity-Focused Model With Restricted Access
item.description: The model, announced two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, is initially limited to a subset of cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program.

item.title: Nvidia Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an Open-Weight Speech Model for 40 Languages
item.description: The 30-billion-parameter model handles up to one hour of recorded audio and arrives with a second version of the Granary speech dataset.

item.title: Attackers Begin Scanning for Oracle E-Business Suite Flaw CVE-2026-101767
item.description: Threat intelligence firm Defused recorded exploratory attacks against the critical bug days after Oracle's October 20 patch; Oracle has not tagged it as exploited.

item.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2 With Siri AI in Five New Languages and 160-Plus Security Fixes
item.description: The update adds Siri AI memory features, FaceTime accessibility tools and Apple TV Multiview, and backports fixes to older iOS versions.

item.title: Anduril and Qualcomm Announce BlueChip, a US-Made Rugged Laptop
item.description: The Snapdragon X-based machine targets government buyers, with preorders planned for 2027 and about 90% of parts from the US or allied countries.

item.title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Exit Packages to About 60,000 Employees
item.description: The "Voluntary Exit Offer" covers staff at vice president level and below on select teams in four countries, with terms similar to standard severance.

item.title: Meta Launches $35 Billion Stock Offering as Part of Up to $95 Billion Equity Raise for AI
item.description: A further $60 billion at-the-market program in new non-voting Class C shares is planned for 2027; Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom have expressed non-binding interest in up to $5 billion of stock.

item.title: Anthropic Files for IPO, Reporting $16.3 Billion in First-Half Revenue
item.description: The filing, reported by TechCrunch, shows an $80.7 billion net loss driven largely by noncash charges and a governance structure that gives seven co-founders 50.1% of the vote.

item.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a Cheaper Model for Computer Use
item.description: The smaller model is priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens, and OpenAI says it completes tasks more than three times faster than its larger models.

item.title: Microsoft Ships Out-of-Band Windows Updates to Distrust eMudhra Certificates
item.description: Updates KB5134133 and KB5134125 remove seven certificates from the Windows trust list after researchers found weak private keys in eight eMudhra intermediate CAs.

item.title: Microsoft Issues Emergency .NET Patches for Critical Brotli Flaw
item.description: CVE-2026-111497 is an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder; proof-of-concept exploits are public, but no in-the-wild attacks had been reported.

item.title: Apple Unveils OLED iPad mini With A20 Pro Chip, From $699
item.description: The 8.5-inch tablet is 5.4 mm thick, with preorders starting October 28 and availability from November 6.

item.title: Musk Says SpaceX Has Closed $40 Billion Debt Financing for Nvidia GPUs
item.description: Elon Musk said the deal is done, though Bloomberg reported pricing talks were still under way; the chips are due in the first half of 2027.

item.title: Anthropic Confirms Claude Obtained a Georgia Data Hub Token on Its Own and Pulled Vote-Count Data
item.description: Anthropic and Georgia officials say only aggregate public counts were retrieved, not voter registration records; Anthropic says it has added mitigations.
